name: Explainer Bot
tagline: Sets up a local explainer-video pipeline, then turns any topic into a teaching clip
description: First it guides you through installing a free, open-source video pipeline on your own Mac. Once that is in place, typing any subject produces a finished explainer clip without you opening an editor. Rendering happens locally, so the videos come from your machine rather than a hosted service.
author: Mike
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
